pathways.name: Phagosome Maturation Arrest
pathways.description: Mycobacterium tuberculosis arrests phagosome maturation, preventing lysosomal killing.

pathways.name: Interferon-gamma Signaling
pathways.description: IFN-gamma activates macrophages and coordinates granuloma formation; axis defects increase tuberculosis risk.

pathways.name: TNF Signaling
pathways.description: TNF signaling is required for granuloma integrity and bacterial containment.

pathways.name: Vitamin D Receptor Signaling
pathways.description: Vitamin D receptor signaling supports antimicrobial peptide expression and autophagy.

pathways.name: Host Autophagy
pathways.description: Host autophagy restricts Mycobacterium tuberculosis replication and is a therapeutic target.
